name: Nullvault BioSeal Cleanroom Coverall Type-F
description:
Glacial white with soft grey piping, the Type-F is the standard-issue cleanroom coverall for Tier 3–4 chip fabrication floors, geneware clinics, and biotech synthesis labs. Cut from antistatic microfilament spunbond fabric with a conductive grid woven at 5mm intervals. The fit is trim without being tailored — designed to minimize particle shedding, not to flatter.

Hood is integrated with a soft face-frame that accepts a clip-on face shield or respirator. BCI port access panel sits at the left temple seam, secured by a dust-sealed magnetic flap. All closures are continuous-zip with over-flap seam tape. Available in Augmented Cut with forearm channel seams for chrome.
functionality: ISO Class 5 particle containment; integrated ESD grounding via conductive grid and sole contact strip; BCI port access panel at left temple; Augmented Cut variant includes forearm channel seams for chrome limb compatibility; continuous-zip over-flap construction eliminates exposed seam gaps.
what_it_says: You work somewhere clean enough to matter, and you follow the protocols.
price_range: Φ95–Φ210 per unit; bulk lab contracts Φ60/unit
story_hooks: A geneware clinic technician notices a colleague's coverall has a non-standard BCI port flap — someone has been accessing the lab's biodata network without authorization.
A batch of Type-F suits was contaminated during manufacture with a trace compound that sets off bioscan alarms — and the workers wearing them have no idea.
A chip fab worker has been hiding a secondary BCI implant under the temple flap for months, running unauthorized data pulls from inside a Tier 4 secure fabrication floor.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Space Elevator Tether System

physical_description.visual_profile: A stark, utilitarian full-body coverall with an integrated hood that frames the face. The silhouette is straight-cut and minimal — no curves, no excess. When worn, it reads as clinical and protective, not fashionable. The glacial white creates an almost sterile appearance, broken only by soft grey piping that traces seams and reinforcement lines.
physical_description.fit: Trim and purposeful, cut to eliminate excess fabric that could shed particles. Not tailored or body-conforming — instead, it hangs with enough room for layered undergarments and augmentation wear beneath. The forearm channels in Augmented Cut variants allow chrome limbs to interface without bulk.
physical_description.primary_material: Antistatic microfilament spunbond composite — lightweight, breathable enough for extended wear, and engineered to minimize particulate release. The conductive grid woven at 5mm intervals is invisible at distance but visible up close as a faint cross-hatching pattern.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and slightly matte to the eye, with a faint static-resistant sheen. Up close, the microfilament has a delicate, almost cloth-like surface; the conductive grid creates subtle texture variations. Feels cool and slightly stiff when new, softening with wear.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant glacial white (near-pure, clinical white with a hint of blue undertone) with soft grey piping along all major seams, hood edge, and zipper flaps. No patterns — the conductive grid is functional, not decorative.
physical_description.closures: Continuous-zip with overlapping seam tape along the full front and side seams. Magnetic dust-sealed flap at left temple for BCI port access. No buttons, snaps, or traditional fasteners — all closures prioritize contamination control.
distinctive_features: Integrated hood with soft face-frame designed to accept clip-on face shields or respirators
Left temple seam BCI port access panel with dust-sealed magnetic closure
5mm conductive grid woven throughout for ESD protection
Continuous-zip front with overlapping seam tape
Forearm channel seams on Augmented Cut variants to accommodate chrome limbs
Dust-sealed design at all potential ingress points
Nullvault branding (discrete, embossed) at left chest
Reinforced shoulder and knee panels (slightly raised texture)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional corporate issue. Standard-issue for mid-tier biotech and chip fabrication workers. Signals employment in regulated, high-precision industries rather than wealth or status.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by chip fab technicians, geneware clinic staff, biotech synthesis lab workers, and contamination-control specialists. Identifies the wearer as part of the technical workforce in controlled environments. Zero fashion value — pure functionality. Wearing one off-site signals either a shift break or someone cutting corners on safety protocols.
physical_description.condition_typical: When new, pristine and stiff. With regular use, it becomes soft and slightly creased, particularly at elbows and knees. Wear patterns emerge along zipper tracks and hood edges. Occasional patch-repairs appear on high-stress seams. Conductive grid remains visible throughout lifespan. No visible soiling if worn correctly; if visibly stained, the wearer is marked as careless.
